business_problem: Zilong Game needed to stop gold-farming and increasingly complex cheating in Ragnarok X: Next Generation before those behaviors destabilized the in-game economy, damaged PvP fairness, and weakened long-term player retention across global markets.
solution_summary: Zilong Game used Tencent Cloud to turn game security for Ragnarok X: Next Generation into a continuous detection system rather than a purely reactive response workflow. The deployment combines Tencent Cloud Anti-Cheat Expert with AI-powered protection models and dual-platform anti-cheat SDKs. Player behavior, economic activity, and client signals are monitored in real time; aggregated telemetry is analyzed to surface abnormal transaction chains and gold-farming behavior, while the SDK layer hardens both client environments against accelerators, memory modifiers, emulator abuse, and other exploit paths. The same setup supports earlier interception of black-market actors before inflation and unfair play spread through the title. By joining AI-based economic protection with client-side anti-cheat controls, Tencent Cloud gave Zilong a security architecture that protects both the gameplay loop and the virtual economy across large-scale live operations.

data_flow: Gameplay telemetry, transaction behavior, and client signals flow into Tencent Cloud's protection stack, where AI-powered models identify suspicious economic patterns and Anti-Cheat Expert plus deployed SDKs enforce protections against cheats, emulator abuse, and abnormal multi-endpoint activity.
business_outcome: Zilong Game gained proactive protection for both cheating and economic abuse, helping Ragnarok X preserve fair competition, stabilize its in-game economy, and maintain player trust at global scale.
architecture_clues: The publisher distributes titles in more than 30 global markets.
The design pairs AI-based economic analysis with dual-platform SDK hardening.
The deployment is intended to catch abnormal transaction chains and black-market activity before they spread.
evidence_quotes: AI-powered protection models analyze aggregated in-game behavioral data to accurately identify abnormal transaction chains and gold-farming patterns, safeguarding the stability of the in-game economy.

A dual-client hardening strategy was implemented by deploying anti-cheat SDKs across both platforms, blocking multi-endpoint cheating scenarios and preventing exploit attempts from emulators, modified clients, or alternative runtime environments.
Pre-emptive threat detection based on real-time monitoring enables early interception of malicious actors, effectively raising the entry threshold for black market activities.

Tencent Cloud Anti-Cheat Expert transforms game security from reactive defense into proactive, intelligent protection, safeguarding fairness, economic stability, and long-term player trust at global scale.
